Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.commitmentBody: At BagajPark, the security of our users' personal data is our top priority. Your data is protected using modern encryption standards and processes compliant with GDPR and local regulations.
Privacy.a1: To provide our services, we collect your name, email, phone number, and location data during reservations. Your payment information is processed directly by our licensed payment provider (service provider) and is not stored on our servers.
Privacy.a2: Collected data is used solely to process your bookings, ensure security, manage communication with shop owners, and fulfill our legal obligations.
Privacy.a3: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience, keep your session secure, and analyze usage statistics.
Privacy.a4: Your data is never shared or sold to third parties, except for our business partners essential for service delivery (service provider, map services) and legal authorities.
Privacy.a5: Personal data is maintained as long as your membership is active or for required legal retention periods. When you close your account, your data is anonymized or deleted.
Privacy.a6: All data transfers are encrypted via SSL/TLS protocols. Our servers undergo regular security scans, and access permissions are strictly monitored.
Privacy.footerBody: For any questions regarding our privacy policy or requests under data protection laws, you can contact us at any time.

FAQ.title: F.A.Q.
FAQ.subtitle: Your questions answered.
FAQ.partnerPitchBody: Turn spare space into revenue—learn how applications and commissions work.
FAQ.a1: Yes. Partner shops follow platform rules; bags are sealed and photographed at drop-off. Protection up to 10,000 TL per bag applies under the conditions described in our Terms — it complements shop operations and is not a standalone retail policy.
FAQ.q2: How do refunds work if I cancel?
FAQ.a2: You can cancel anytime before your check-in time for a full refund to your card — no hidden conditions.
FAQ.a3: Pay online with major credit and debit cards through our secure provider (service provider). Cash is not accepted. Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal can be enabled via service provider when we activate that gateway — we will announce it on the site.
FAQ.q4: What if the shop is closed or I need help?
FAQ.a4: Contact us via the contact page or WhatsApp. We will help you reschedule, find another nearby storage point, or resolve issues with your booking.
FAQ.q5: What does the insurance line on checkout cover?
FAQ.a5: The insurance fee on checkout contributes to the protection package described in our Terms (up to 10,000 TL per bag when conditions are met). Exact scope, exclusions and claims are set out in the Terms and related notices — read them before you book.
FAQ.a6: You send a request with your dates and bag sizes. The shop reviews and approves. You then complete payment if required and receive a QR code to show at drop-off. This is a request flow — instant confirmation may vary by shop.
FAQ.a7: Yes. We use S, M and XL slots with different daily rates. Choose the size that matches your luggage. Oversized or unusual items may need partner approval — ask support before booking.
FAQ.a8: No. Only online card payments (and future wallet options) are accepted. This keeps a clear payment trail and aligns with platform protection rules.
FAQ.a2Onsite: You can cancel free of charge any time before your check-in. Because payment is taken at the shop, cancelling means you are never charged. No hidden terms.
FAQ.a3Onsite: You pay at the shop where you drop off your luggage — in cash or on the partner's card terminal. No card details are asked for when you book. Online payment is coming soon; we'll announce it on the site.

istanbul.label: Istanbul
istanbul.metaDescription: Secure luggage storage in Istanbul near Sultanahmet, Taksim, Kadikoy. Book online and explore the city hands-free.
istanbul.headline: Luggage storage in Istanbul
istanbul.intro: Simplify your travel with our secure luggage storage points in key areas like the Historic Peninsula, Galata Tower, Istiklal Street, and Kadikoy. There is no need to carry heavy suitcases while visiting Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet Square, or the Grand Bazaar. Leave your bags sealed with trusted local partners and enjoy the Bosphorus without any weight.

sections.title: Luggage Storage in Istanbul's Most Popular Districts
sections.body: Istanbul is a vast metropolis spread across two continents, Europe and Asia, each district having its own unique character. In Sultanahmet, you can securely store your luggage while visiting Hagia Sophia, the Basilica Cistern, and the Grand Bazaar, then freely wander the narrow historic streets. Around Taksim and Istiklal Street, you don't need to carry heavy suitcases while shopping among 19th-century buildings or riding the famous nostalgic tram. Our BagajPark points are within walking distance of these busy areas. On the Asian side, our Kadikoy and Moda coast locations are conveniently close to ferry docks.
sections.keywords: Sultanahmet luggage storage, Taksim bag storage, Istiklal Street luggage

sections.title: Exploring Istanbul Baggage-Free After Check-Out
sections.body: The time between checking out of your hotel and your flight can be the most productive part of your Istanbul trip. BagajPark offers the perfect solution, especially for tourists checking out of hotels in the Sultanahmet area. After breakfast, drop your suitcases at the nearest storage point and spend the day visiting Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar with ease. In the evening, pick up your luggage and head to the airport without returning to your hotel. Cruise ship passengers can also drop their luggage at our Karakoy or Eminonu points and enjoy a day trip in Istanbul.
sections.keywords: check-out luggage storage Istanbul, hotel checkout bag storage, last day baggage-free

sections.title: City Center Luggage Storage vs Airport Left Luggage
sections.body: While both Istanbul Airport (IST) and Sabiha Gokcen Airport (SAW) have left luggage offices, their distance from the city center makes them inconvenient just for dropping bags. Airport storage prices in 2026 start at 210 TL for small bags and 550 TL for large bags. With BagajPark, you can store your luggage at much more affordable rates at locations near your hotel or travel route in the city center. Our points in Sultanahmet, Taksim, Kadikoy, and Besiktas let you store your bags without deviating from your itinerary. Plus, online booking means no waiting when you arrive.
sections.keywords: Istanbul Airport luggage storage price, city center bag storage, IST left luggage alternative

tips: Your luggage is sealed with numbered security tags for safety

ankara.label: Ankara
ankara.metaDescription: Safe baggage storage in Ankara near Kizilay, Tunali, ATG Train Station. Online booking for hands-free travel in the capital.
ankara.headline: Luggage storage in Ankara
ankara.intro: Enjoy a comfortable trip to Ankara with storage locations around Kizilay, Tunali Hilmi, Cankaya, and the High-Speed Train Station (ATG). Free yourself of luggage while climbing the steep hills of Ankara Castle or exploring the Museum of Ancient Civilizations. Store your bags during business meetings or museum visits.

sections.title: Bag Storage in Ankara City Center
sections.body: When arriving in Ankara via YHT high-speed train, you can store your luggage before heading to Kizilay. Kizilay Square and its surroundings are the most vibrant area of Ankara, filled with shopping malls, cafes, and restaurants. Use BagajPark points instead of carrying suitcases while strolling down Tunali Hilmi Street or relaxing at Kugulu Park. You can also securely store your luggage before visiting Anitkabir, Ataturk's Mausoleum.
